name: Faster Floor Results
description: The floor results screen after an escalator replays your route at {{speed}} instead of 30, so you can move on as soon as the next floor is ready.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Replay speed
settings.help: How fast the map replays your time on the floor. The game's own is 30; 600 is 20 times that. The Next prompt waits for the replay to finish.

patches.description: Shorter map open and close (0.1 s instead of 0.6 s)
